item: Row J J1: a source is keyed on (domain, feed); the schema, the safe rebuild, the ordered lookups and the restore-merge join
summary: UNIQUE (domain) becomes UNIQUE (domain, feed_key) with typed feed keys (f: prefix, feed-less = empty, R145). The table rebuild turns foreign-key enforcement off outside a transaction and refuses if it cannot, because DROP TABLE with it on deletes the ON DELETE CASCADE children of every source; ids are carried over and compared before the drop. Every by-domain single-row read goes through source_for_domain (lowest id; AST guard), and the restore-merge matches on (domain, feed_key) with the key recomputed by the one normaliser, with a one-to-one fallback so a corrected feed is not resurrected as a second source. No new source rows are registered yet (J3); the independence gates are J2. Measured on the production seeder capture: the 475 shadowed entries become 216 new rows, 235 tag merges and 24 unregistered.
